title: Poker DEALER button — white acrylic casino puck, 'DEALER' on the face; rotates clockwise each hand. (Small/Big-blind markers are the same puck recoloured blue/yellow with SB/BB text.)
era: Modern casino/home poker. The dealer button ('the buck') marks who acts last / deals; it moves clockwise one seat each hand.
scope_note: Owner asked for Dealer / SB / BB markers, OK without a photo (standard objects). modelgen builds the canonical DEALER puck (readable 'DEALER' text per law 7); the SB/BB markers are the same puck recoloured + relabelled in-scene (blue SMALL BLIND, yellow BIG BLIND).

sources.wiki_button: Wikipedia «Button (poker)» — the dealer button is 'a marker used to indicate the player who is dealing or … acts last'; modern button is 'typically a white plastic disc with the word "Dealer" on each side'; it 'was moved clockwise around the table after each hand'; separate blind lammers/buttons can be 'put in front of the players to show they owe the indicated amounts' — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Button_(poker)
sources.brybelly_casino: Brybelly «3-inch Casino Grade Dealer Button» — 3 in (76.2 mm) diameter, 0.875 in (22.2 mm) thick, quality acrylic, double-sided (white face/black engraving, black face/white engraving), black O-ring rubber edge bumpers — https://www.amazon.com/Brybelly-Casino-Grade-Dealer-Button/dp/B001X3U02G
sources.mrcpoker_jumbo: MRC Poker «3-inch Jumbo Acrylic Dealer Button» — 3 in (76.2 mm) Ø, 0.75 in (19.05 mm) thick acrylic puck — https://mrcpoker.com/products/3-inch-jumbo-acrylic-dealer-button
sources.gse_blinds: GSE «Dealer/Small Blind/Big Blind buttons» — home/tournament 3-marker set: DEALER + SMALL BLIND + BIG BLIND, common colour convention white/blue/yellow — https://www.amazon.com/GSE-Games-Sports-Expert-Buttons/dp/B07WHFGCXL
sources.pokernews_button: PokerNews «The Dealer Button» — in casino play the dealer button is the only physical marker; blinds are set by position relative to the button; it advances clockwise each hand — https://www.pokernews.com/strategy/casino-poker-for-beginners-07-the-dealer-button-29299.htm

dealer.text: «DEALER» on the face (Wikipedia: 'a white plastic disc with the word Dealer on each side')
dealer.note: Casino-standard Ø = 3 in (76.2 mm). Thickness 20 mm is the chunky casino-puck look (sourced range 19–22 mm); flat retail discs run ~6 mm. Bigger than a chip (40 mm) — reads as the dealer button on the table.
dealer.src: wiki_button (white disc, 'DEALER' both sides) + brybelly_casino (3 in / 22.2 mm, acrylic) + mrcpoker_jumbo (3 in / 19.05 mm)

blinds.convention: Same puck recoloured: white = DEALER, blue = SMALL BLIND, yellow = BIG BLIND (common retail convention, not an enforced standard). Some sets abbreviate D / SB / BB.
blinds.note: Physical SB/BB markers exist mainly in home/tournament sets; in casino play only the dealer button is physical. Built in-scene as recoloured/relabelled pucks.
blinds.src: wiki_button (blind lammers) + gse_blinds (white/blue/yellow D/SB/BB set) + pokernews_button (casino = dealer button only)

derivation.text_plate_m: ≈0.052 × 0.016 — 'DEALER' label sized to sit across the puck face (derived from the 76 mm face)

feature_inventory.feature: White acrylic puck Ø76.2 × 20 mm (chunky casino button)
Rotates clockwise one seat each hand (flavour, not modelled)
SB/BB markers = same puck, blue/yellow, SMALL BLIND/BIG BLIND text (built in-scene)

needs: No reference photo (owner: standard object, OK without). Built from Wikipedia + retailer specs.
Thickness 20 mm chosen for the chunky-puck look — sourced range is 19–22 mm (casino puck) or ~6 mm (flat disc); no sanctioning-body dimensional standard exists
'DEALER' text rendered as a dark plate decal with light lettering (real buttons are black-on-white engraving — inverse, still reads); engraving depth/font/height unsourced
Black O-ring edge bumpers (Brybelly) not modelled in v1
SB/BB exact wording (full words vs SB/BB) + colours are a retail convention, not a standard
